scripts.title: Gem Aura
scripts.features: ⚠️BHOP DETECTED⚠️The GemAura script functions as a comprehensive automation and visualization toolkit managed through an interactive graphical user interface which allows players to customize parameters and assign keybinds to various actions. In the visuals and extra sensory perception department the script offers a highly customizable environment allowing players to toggle wallhack boxes around enemies with specific color settings check teammate status to filter out allies and track health through a dynamic health bar that adapts to remaining hit points. It also includes name displays skeleton rendering to see player posture behind walls a head dot marker for easier targeting tracers originating from the bottom of the screen to focus on target locations and weapon text indicating what firearm each player holds. For model customization it includes viewmodel chams to color hands and weapons in first person self chams to color the player character model and options to hide viewmodels or disable them while in third person mode. The combat and rage systems feature a silent aim system that automatically redirects shots to a selected body part like the head or torso within a defined field of view circle while utilizing a wall check to avoid targeting behind unbangable surfaces. This is complemented by a trigger bot that fires automatically when an enemy enters the crosshair with adjustable delays trigger field of view limits and custom wall checks alongside a kill all function for rapid server clearing. Weapon modifications in this module provide infinite ammo complete recoil removal and a fast fire rate while the anti aim system disrupts enemy targeting by spinning the character hitboxes or using custom pitch values. Movement physics are heavily modified through speed hack adjustments which alter walking speed fly hack capabilities for free roaming in the air and a bunnyhop system featuring acceleration and maximum speed limits. Players can also bypass map collisions using noclip or adjust the camera to a third person view with custom distance settings. Interface and environmental adjustments include a lighting modifier to change brightness clock time exposure compensation ambient colors and outdoor ambient tones. The heads up display can show a spectator list to track who is observing the player an active keybind hud to monitor toggled functions and an aspect ratio changer to distort screen proportions for a wider field of view. For account security and server management the script features a moderator detector that scans for specific administrator user identifiers and executes an automated response such as sending an interactive notification jumping to another public server or kicking the player instantly. There is an automatic rejoin feature acting as vote kick protection which detects if a vote is called against the player and triggers an emergency config save and server reconnect right before the final vote passes. Finally the utility aspect incorporates a skin changer with custom character meshes searchable via a search bar and a local configuration system that automatically manages json files inside a dedicated folder including emergency saves created during moderator detection or vote kicks.
